title: crataegus columbiana var. chrysocarpa
intro: Crataegus columbiana var. chrysocarpa, commonly known as Chrysocarpa Hawthorn, is a variety of hawthorn plant that is native to North America, specifically the Pacific Northwest region. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include lowering blood pressure, improving heart health, and providing antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Crataegus columbiana var. chrysocarpa are attributed to its ability to act as a vasodilator, improving blood flow and reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, such as quercetin and epicatechin, as well as oligomeric proanthocyanidins (OPCs), which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
